My dreams of a dream home have come true.

It's not often I am generous when it comes to complimenting people. I owe a big thank you to Harshal and his team from Hinge architect for converting our house into a beautiful home. We got to know about him through google reviews. We don’t live in Mumbai. Hence we gave him the responsibility of choosing the decor, the furnishings, and the entire burden of setting up our home, except for the white goods. He and his team shouldered the responsibility and made our house a marvellous place to stay.
The furnishings, the fit-out, the beds, the walking closet, the dining area, and the doors all look so classy, wonderfully designed and fitted.

Mind you; all this has happened without our supervision. The materials used for the beds, the cupboards, and the washrooms everything has been as promised.
The team has always been prompt in attending to our requests, and they have implemented the same in the design.

Thank you so much, Harshal and team, for your teamwork, and I wanted you to know the design is the best. We have only great things to tell people about your firm and your work on our new home.

name: Tushar Chhatbar Architects
description:
Tushar Chhatbar Architects is multi disciplinary firm. We enjoy a 360 degree approach right from master planning to the smallest product details. We want to build something that can stay relevant in the perspective of time.
Our work operates within the cultural context of the country and yet suggests that each project is a product of cultural mutation and reinvention. We try and maintain the spirit of each location, desire of people and attempt to integrate the real, imaginary and symbolic with ease. Our work questions the political and ethical responsibility of the contemporary Indian designer and is concerned with its public consequences.
We aim for simplicity, conceptual rigors and material invention.

featured_reviews.name: Mehul Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Working with Architect Sameer Durve and Associates has been nothing short of extraordinary. From the very first conversation to the final execution, their team demonstrated a rare blend of vision, precision, and genuine care that is hard to find today.

What truly sets them apart is their design intelligence, every concept is not just aesthetically stunning, but deeply thoughtful and purposeful. They don’t just design spaces; they craft experiences. Every detail feels intentional, every corner tells a story, and every plan reflects both creativity and practicality.

Their planning and execution are equally remarkable. The level of organization, foresight, and discipline they bring ensures that even complex projects move forward smoothly. Deadlines are respected, challenges are handled proactively, and nothing is ever left to chance.

But beyond their technical excellence, it is their patience and commitment that make them exceptional. They take the time to truly understand your vision, refine it, and elevate it, without ever rushing the process. Their ability to listen, adapt, and guide with clarity shows not just capability, but character.

The team’s capacity and capability to handle scale, complexity, and detail simultaneously is impressive. No matter the size or challenge of the project, they approach it with the same level of dedication and enthusiasm.

Most importantly, their intent is pure. They genuinely want the best outcome for you. It never feels transactional; it feels like a partnership built on trust, passion, and excellence.

If you’re looking for architects who combine creativity, professionalism, reliability, and heart, Architect Sameer Durve and Associates are simply outstanding.

Highly recommended: with deep appreciation and respect.
(I’ve done 8 office and residential projects with them so far… and the 9th one which is 400Acres at Pennsylvania, US is the next in line).
